attempts.why: Header .nav is a non-wrapping flex row with intrinsic width 572px on a 375px viewport causing document horizontal overflow; allowing wrap/shrink keeps content within the viewport without hiding it.

selfVerify.reason: docScrollWidth 375 equals viewport 375 so horizontal overflow eliminated; .nav wraps to 375x139 (nav-links 288x24 on second row, buttons on third) with all content visible and no clipping/hiding.
